name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when searching for a luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when searching for a luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls in a luxury condo search include overlooking critical HOA financial details, not thoroughly inspecting the property, and underestimating the total cost of ownership beyond the purchase price. Buyers sometimes get swept up by aesthetics and fail to consider the long-term implications of building management, potential assessments, or rental restrictions. Another pitfall is not understanding the true value of included amenities and whether they align with your lifestyle. A comprehensive checklist and professional guidance can help avoid these issues.
